verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a workspace or project export feature, let alone one that preserves comments, attachments and audit trails. The REST API and its file download_url endpoint are developer building blocks that someone could use to build an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit. Data portability is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
